text.p: Singapore Telecommunications Ltd (SingTel) said on Wednesday it had signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Datacraft Asia Ltd to provide telecommunications services and equipment.
Under the agreement, SingTel would provide international leased circuits, frame relay and ISDN services, a company statement said.
Datacraft, a communications and network systems integrator, would provide, maintain and manage the network equipment for such services for customers outside Singapore, it added.
"Together with Datacraft, SingTel can now offer a one-stop shop," Lim Eng, vice president of SingTel's business communications, said in the statement.

"When they (multinationals) order leased circuits or any of the other services from SingTel, they will get a network that is customised to their unique needs using SingTel's services and Datacraft's equipment," Lim said.
SingTel would maintain customers' networks and liase with multiple vendors across different time zones, Lim said.
